metadata.name: lst-lending-contagion-proof-downstream
metadata.description: Downstream lending component for the cross-protocol contagion proof. Five whale positions share a single pool; collateral price comes ONLY from the declared bridge reading upstream liquid-staking pool.exchange_rate_bps. The terminal liquidation cascade at tick 4 runs after the bridge has already dropped the collateral oracle from $100 to $60 (upstream slash at tick 3), so the realized bad debt is attributable to the upstream depeg, not to a manual lending-side oracle trajectory.
